newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT-East Asia rated a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-East Asia rated a buy.

text.p: Angping & Associates Securities on Wednesday rated East Asia Power Resources Corp a buy because its power projects "have secured revenue flow up to 1998."
East Asia operates several diesel-powered generating plants in the country.
East Asia is planning to acquire 51 percent stake in a 30-megawatt coal plant in China and a 20 percent stake in a 32-megawatt diesel plant in Indonesia.
Recently, it signed a memorandum of agreement to acquire 60 percent of a power company in British Virgin Islands.
"The growth of the company will be based solely on the bagging of new power projects," analyst Alexis Cabel said.
He added the company also plans to forge partnership with its direct clients such as cement and water utility companies.
